prompts.name: hand_flat.png
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production transparent PNG sprite for existing Overlock anime sewing game. Use reference 1 concept art ONLY for the hand pose; reference 2 original hand.png for skin tone, drawing style and cream sleeve with purple ruffled cuff.
Output ONLY ONE isolated hand sprite, the hand on the RIGHT SIDE OF THE SCREEN in reference 1. Transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard painted into image, no tabletop, cloth, face, UI, text, needle, or other hand. Landscape 4:3 canvas preferably 1280x960.
Redraw original raised hand to rest FLAT palm-down on an implied horizontal surface, viewed with low grazing perspective toward character. Back of hand and nails visible. Wrist lowered to same surface as palm heel and fingers, forearm extends horizontally out toward RIGHT image edge, never diagonally upward. Cream sleeve and purple cuff attached. Relaxed flat fingers foreshortened, fingers extend toward lower left, thumb is on upper-left inner side. EXACTLY five digits total including thumb, with clear gaps. The heel of palm and pads all rest at same plane; no clawing, no hovering, no raised wrist.
Composition: hand plus sleeve fills width with 4% transparent margin; sleeve ends near x96%, wrist near x74% y43%, thumb tip near x15% y48%, four fingers reach lower-left and bottom around y80%, upper silhouette no higher than y25%. No drop shadow outside silhouette: contact shadows will be drawn by engine. Keep full hand silhouette unclipped. Crisp warm cel-shaded anime linework matching original sprite. No jewelry, injuries, bandages or thimble. This will be mirrored in engine to make other hand; do not include pair.

prompts.name: presser_foot_large.png
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE isolated game sprite of the SILVER PRESSER FOOT ONLY, same recognizable foot as reference 1, more crisp detailed cel shaded metallic anime rendering matching reference 2. High resolution portrait or near square canvas, full silhouette with 8 percent transparent margin. Straight frontal symmetric view at low grazing tabletop angle, broad two flat toes resting on same baseline, open central U-shaped slot between toes extending from front edge toward rear. Dark joint bearings left and right, central mounting upright above rear bridge. It must remain a compact presser foot, not whole sewing machine. NO needle, NO long overhead vertical needle bar, these are independent animated layers. The U-shaped slot must be genuinely transparent, as is all background.
